benchmarks.where: edge of the box, central (16.5 m)

benchmarks.note: fixed value (Wyscout), not the open-play model

result.model: xG = Soccermatics' logistic fit on 8,451 PL 2017/18 shots (Wyscout); after a pass = P(complete, our pass model) x that xG from the receiver's spot when the pass is played
result.order: values[j][i]: j = y index from the NEAR touchline (centre j + 0.5 m), i = x index from the left goal line (centre i + 0.5 m); the goal attacked is at x = 105 (mirror x for the other end); 0 in the attacker's own half (no shots there in the data); positions on the goal line valued 0.5 m out
result.source: evals.pitchwatch.shotxg.reference_xg (Soccermatics' published logistic fit; we use its coefficients, we did not fit it)
